description:
Return registration trend data for a TLD over time, or compare multiple TLDs, in active-total or newly-registered mode.

Related: tld_rank, keywords_trends.

action.description: 'data' for single TLD deep-dive, 'compare' for multi-TLD comparison

tld.description: Single TLD for 'data' mode, gTLDs only (e.g., 'com', 'xyz'). Country-code TLDs are not covered and return an error.

tlds.description: Comma-separated TLDs for 'compare' mode (max 5, gTLDs only, e.g. 'xyz,online,shop,store'). Country-code TLDs such as io, ai, co are not covered by this dataset.

type.description: 'newly' for daily new registrations, 'active' for total active domains

name: tld_trends

data.description: In 'data' mode: array of data points. In 'compare' mode: object keyed by TLD name, each value is an array of data points.

oneOf.description: Compare mode: keyed by TLD name

notice.description: Compare mode only: present when some requested TLDs had no data; explains which and why.

tlds_missing.description: Compare mode only: requested TLDs that returned no trend data.

title: gTLD Registration Trends
